meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Hermes adaptation with minimal notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件持久化任务计划，避免上下文丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在AI对话中管理复杂、多步骤的工作计划
copy.tagline_en: Persist task plans to files, survive context loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage complex, multi-step plans in AI conversations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在项目目录中创建并维护三个 Markdown 文件：task_plan.md（任务计划）、findings.md（发现记录）和 progress.md（进度日志）。每次执行复杂任务前，它会先读取这些文件恢复上下文，并在每个阶段完成后更新它们，从而在对话被清除后仍能继续工作。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划、分解或组织一个多步骤项目、研究任务或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建任务计划文件并开始分阶段执行。

say.text: 记录刚才的发现到 findings.md。
更新进度，标记第一阶段完成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three Markdown files in the project directory: task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. Before each complex task, it reads these files to restore context, and updates them after each phase, allowing work to survive context loss or /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-step project and create task_plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude creates the plan file and starts phased execution.

say_en.text: Log the recent discovery to findings.md.
say_en.note: Claude writes the finding to findings.md.
Claude updates progress.md and marks the phase status.
